summary: The RNA-seq (GSE98084: 4 D. japonica samples, supplementary FPKM tables, SRA SRP104988) is public and is the only barium-adaptation expression dataset found. Head loss, regrowth and survival counts, any time course and acute-stress controls are not deposited anywhere I could find.
next_step: Pre-register the 'handful' threshold, confirm the replicate structure from the GEO sample records, and extract the phenotype tallies from the iScience paper text.
obstacles_confirmed: Only 4 samples are listed for GSE98084, which limits how stable a differentially-expressed gene list can be.
Anatomical time course and survival tallies are not in the expression series.
